name: Belzutifan (HIF-2-alpha inhibitor, later-line clear-cell RCC)
cyclesNote: Continuous oral belzutifan 120 mg once daily until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Used after both a checkpoint inhibitor and an anti-angiogenic agent.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Class-specific anemia and hypoxia are expected; monitor hemoglobin and oxygen saturation.
Counsel that supplemental oxygen may be needed; avoid masking hypoxia symptoms.

doseModificationRules.condition: symptomatic or grade 3 anemia or hypoxia
doseModificationRules.text: Hold belzutifan for grade 3 anemia (transfuse as indicated) or grade 3 hypoxia; resume at a reduced dose (e.g. 80 mg then 40 mg once daily) per labeling once recovered. Discontinue for grade 4 or recurrent grade 3 hypoxia.

drugs.name: Belzutifan
drugs.notes: Belzutifan 120 mg PO once daily, continuous (shown across all cycle days). Oral HIF-2-alpha inhibitor for advanced clear-cell RCC after a checkpoint inhibitor and an anti-angiogenic agent. Anemia and hypoxia are class effects requiring hemoglobin and oxygen-saturation monitoring. Authored from standard later-line RCC practice (NCCN Kidney Cancer; LITESPARK-005 supporting evidence).
